items.prompt: Write a complete 4-sentence informative paragraph about one kind of weather (rain, snow, thunder, or wind). Include an introductory sentence that names the topic, two facts, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Snow is a type of frozen precipitation that falls when temperatures are very cold. Snowflakes form in clouds when water droplets freeze around tiny dust particles. No two snowflakes are exactly alike, and each one has a unique six-sided shape. Snow is one of nature's most beautiful and interesting weather events.

steps: Sentence 1: topic sentence naming the weather type.
Sentences 2-3: two specific facts.
Sentence 4: closing sentence.

items.prompt:
Read this paragraph and list everything that needs to be improved:

'Animals are nice. They live in places. Some animals eat plants and some eat meat. Animals are very interesting to learn about.'

Then rewrite the paragraph with improvements.
items.answer: Problems: 'Animals are nice' is vague and opinion-like. 'They live in places' is too vague. The paragraph needs a clearer topic and more specific facts. Improved: 'Animals are living creatures that can be found in every part of the world. Some animals eat only plants and are called herbivores, while others eat meat and are called carnivores. Animals have adapted to survive in many different environments, from deserts to the deep ocean. The animal kingdom is one of the most diverse and fascinating areas of nature.'

steps: Identify vague or weak sentences.
Replace vague language with specific facts.
Make sure every sentence teaches the reader something new.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph about how a caterpillar becomes a butterfly. Include an introductory sentence, two or three facts in order, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: A caterpillar goes through an amazing process to become a butterfly. First, the caterpillar eats many leaves and grows bigger. Then it forms a chrysalis, which is a protective shell around its body. Inside the chrysalis, the caterpillar slowly changes into a butterfly. This process, called metamorphosis, is one of the most incredible transformations in nature.

steps: Topic sentence introduces the transformation.
Facts follow in time order: eating, forming chrysalis, changing inside.
Closing sentence names the process and wraps up.

items.prompt: A student wrote: 'Plants are important. They make food. We should protect them.' Expand this into a strong 4-sentence informative paragraph by adding specific details to each sentence.
items.answer: Plants are essential living things that provide food and oxygen for nearly all life on Earth. Plants make their own food through a process called photosynthesis, using sunlight, water, and air. Protecting plants is important because losing forests means losing the homes of countless animals. By taking care of plants and trees, we help keep our planet healthy for all living things.

steps: Expand 'Plants are important' with a specific reason.
Expand 'They make food' with how (photosynthesis).
Expand 'We should protect them' with why (animal homes, planet health).
Add a closing sentence.

items.prompt: Choose a community helper (firefighter, nurse, librarian, or teacher). Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about that person's job. Include a topic sentence, two facts, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Librarians are community helpers who work in libraries to help people find books and information. A librarian organizes thousands of books so they are easy to find and checks books out to visitors. Librarians also plan story times, reading programs, and activities for children. Librarians play an important role in helping people of all ages learn and discover new ideas.

steps: Topic sentence: who the helper is and where they work.
Fact 1: what task they do.
Fact 2: another task or responsibility.
Closing: summarize their importance.

items.prompt:
Evaluate this informative paragraph for its strengths and weaknesses:

'Deserts are hot. They do not have much water. Some animals live there. Deserts are weird places.'

Then rewrite it as a strong paragraph.
items.answer: Strengths: the topic is clear (deserts) and there are some basic facts. Weaknesses: facts are very general, and 'weird places' is an opinion. Improved: 'Deserts are dry environments that receive very little rainfall each year. Despite the extreme heat during the day, desert nights can be very cold. Many animals, such as camels, lizards, and snakes, have special adaptations that help them survive with very little water. Deserts cover about one-fifth of the Earth's surface and are found on every continent.'

steps: List what works (topic is named, some facts present).
List what is weak (vague, one opinion sentence).
Rewrite with specific facts and remove the opinion.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph about why sleep is important for children. Include an introductory sentence, two or three facts, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Sleep is an important part of staying healthy, especially for growing children. When children sleep, their brains store new information learned during the day, which helps with memory. Sleep also helps the body grow and repair itself, including muscles and the immune system. Children who get enough sleep usually feel happier, focus better in school, and have more energy. Getting enough sleep every night is one of the best things a child can do for their health.

steps: Topic sentence: why sleep matters for children.
Facts: brain memory, body growth, mood and focus.
Closing: recommend getting enough sleep.

items.prompt: A student wrote a paragraph with a strong topic sentence and two good facts, but the closing sentence is: 'So that is what I learned about dolphins.' Rewrite the closing sentence to make it more informative and powerful.
items.answer: Dolphins are intelligent, social animals that continue to fascinate scientists and ocean-lovers around the world.

steps: 'So that is what I learned' focuses on the writer, not the topic.
A stronger closing focuses on the subject and leaves the reader with a key takeaway.
Reference the key qualities of dolphins (intelligent, social) from the paragraph.

items.prompt: Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph about water. Include: where water is found, why it is important, and one interesting fact about water.
items.answer: Water is one of the most important substances on Earth, covering about 71 percent of the planet's surface. Most of the water on Earth is found in the oceans, but fresh water for drinking comes from rivers, lakes, and underground springs. Water is essential for all living things because every cell in every plant, animal, and human needs water to survive. Interestingly, a person can survive weeks without food but only a few days without water.

steps: Topic sentence: water is important, covers much of Earth.
Fact 1: where water is found.
Fact 2: why water is essential.
Closing/interesting fact: survival time.

items.prompt: Pick any topic you are interested in (sports, space, food, animals, etc.). Write a 4-sentence informative paragraph with an introductory sentence, two facts, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: Soccer is one of the most popular sports in the world, played by millions of people in almost every country. In soccer, two teams of eleven players try to kick a ball into the other team's goal without using their hands. The player who guards the goal, called the goalkeeper, is the only player allowed to touch the ball with their hands. Soccer is a fast and exciting sport that teaches teamwork, fitness, and skill.

steps: Topic sentence: name the sport and say something notable about it.
Fact 1: how the game is played.
Fact 2: a specific rule or role.
Closing: summarize what the sport teaches or why it matters.

items.prompt: What is the difference between a fact and a detail? Use a topic about the ocean to give an example of each.
items.answer: A fact is something true about the topic in general. A detail adds more specific information to a fact. For the ocean: Fact: 'The ocean is home to many animals.' Detail: 'Blue whales, the largest animals on Earth, live in the ocean and can grow up to 100 feet long.'

steps: A fact makes a general true statement.
A detail is specific information that explains or expands the fact.
Together, facts and details make informative writing stronger.

items.prompt: Write two different closing sentences for the same paragraph about mountains. One should be weak and one should be strong. Explain the difference.
items.answer: Weak closing: 'That is all about mountains.' Strong closing: 'Mountains are breathtaking landforms that have shaped the lives and cultures of people who have lived near them for thousands of years.' The strong closing connects back to the topic and leaves the reader with a meaningful takeaway, while the weak closing just announces the end.

steps: A weak closing announces that the writing is over without adding meaning.
A strong closing restates the importance of the topic or offers a final thought.

items.prompt:
Read these scrambled sentences and put them in the correct order for an informative paragraph about the water cycle:

1. The water falls back to Earth as rain or snow.
2. Water from oceans, lakes, and rivers heats up and turns into water vapor.
3. The water vapor rises into the sky and forms clouds.
4. The water cycle is the endless journey water takes through our environment.
items.answer: Correct order: 2, 3, 1, 4. The water cycle paragraph should follow the process: evaporation (2), then cloud formation (3), then precipitation (1), then closing (4).

steps: Step 1: water evaporates (sentence 2).
Step 2: vapor rises and forms clouds (sentence 3).
Step 3: water falls as rain or snow (sentence 1).
Step 4: closing sentence (sentence 4).

items.prompt: A student's paragraph about the library has a topic sentence and a closing sentence but the two middle facts are: 'The library has books' and 'People go there.' These facts are too vague. Write two better, more specific facts.
items.answer: Better fact 1: 'Libraries have thousands of books organized by subject and author so visitors can easily find what they are looking for.' Better fact 2: 'At many libraries, people can also borrow movies, use computers, and attend free story time events for children.'

steps: 'The library has books' is too vague. Add how books are organized or what kinds are available.
'People go there' tells nothing. Replace with what people actually do at the library.

items.prompt: Write an informative paragraph about what makes a good friend. Include a topic sentence that introduces the idea, two or three specific facts or characteristics, and a closing sentence.
items.answer: A good friend is someone who is kind, honest, and caring. Good friends listen when you talk and support you when you are feeling sad or scared. A good friend also tells the truth, even when it is hard, because they want what is best for you. Having a good friend makes life more fun and helps you feel safe and understood.

steps: Topic sentence: define what a good friend is.
Fact 1: good friends listen and support.
Fact 2: good friends are honest.
Closing: why having a good friend matters.
